- What it is not: not for BYO-harness-model workflows (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-not-for`). A first-party local Agent CLI that owns the loop is not established (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-not-local-cli`)

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:

- Secondary roles: named Agent harness as `runtime` (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-secondary-runtime`); Project Editor as `ide` (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-secondary-ide`)
- Agent-loop owner: Replit owns and fixes the Agent model and loop (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-agent-loop-owner`). Mapper-shaped value is `supported` (`claim-replit-agent-sf-loop-supported`)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: Lite / Economy / Power (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-model-strategy`); Max retired in favour of Power (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-modes-max-retired`); Turbo is Power-only on Pro and Enterprise (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-modes-turbo`). Product-page vocabulary still says “Extended Thinking” and “High-Power Models” — kept, not averaged (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-modes-marketing`). Per-mode primary model catalog is rolling (`claim-replit-agent-sf-model-selector`). Effort Low–Max is per-model, not a separate mode (`claim-replit-agent-sf-effort`). Compare models beta, up to 4 (`claim-replit-agent-sf-compare-models`)
- Auth strategy: Replit account sign-in on desktop (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-auth-desktop`); SSO / SAML on Enterprise (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-auth-sso`). Prior SCIM row was unknown (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-auth-scim`); SCIM is now Enterprise-only (`claim-replit-agent-sf-scim`) and Enterprise pairs SSO/SAML with SCIM (`claim-replit-agent-sf-enterprise-sso-scim`)
- Provider support: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter for app integrations (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-provider-support`)
- BYOK: apps-only. User can bring keys for models the app calls; the Agent harness model cannot be swapped (`claim-replit-agent-nw-r-byok-apps-only`). `field=byok` is `unsupported` for the harness (`claim-replit-agent-sf-016`). Do not write `field=byok` as supported.
- Subscription reuse: unknown. ChatGPT/Claude connectors drive Replit; they do not power the Agent harness from those subscriptions (`claim-replit-agent-sf-017`).
- Local models: unsupported. The model that powers the Agent experience itself runs on Replit's infrastructure and can't be swapped (`claim-replit-agent-sf-local-models`)
